data.action: 左手压住长凳上备用制服的袖口，右手把软尺拉到肩缝，低头鼓腮检查袖长。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, closed sports outfit and measuring hands on the bench visible
data.description: 体育课后，娜娜穿扣好的藏蓝运动外套和长运动裤，坐在更衣室木长凳旁检查备用水手服的袖长。白衬衫平摊在长凳上，她左手压住袖口，右手把软尺拉到肩缝，看到偏大的尺寸便鼓起两腮。粉色双马尾在肩后摆动，黑色心形尾巴轻拍凳脚——「哼！明明选了正确尺码，袖子怎么还是这么长！我可不想上课时一直卷袖子！」半开的铁柜、挂好的毛巾与地面运动包形成背景，顶灯照尺面与白布，凳下留柔影。
data.lighting: warm ceiling light on the laid-out white sleeve and tape; soft shade beneath the bench
data.location: 女生体育更衣室木长凳旁，半开铁柜与挂毛巾在后方
data.mood: 尺码偏大后的气鼓鼓喜剧
data.promptProse: A spare white sailor blouse lies flat on the locker-room wooden bench while Nana checks its unexpectedly long sleeve. Wearing a fully closed navy sports jacket and matching track trousers, she presses the cuff with her left hand and draws a soft tape toward the shoulder seam with her right. Her cheeks puff in frustration beneath pink twintails, and the black heart-tipped tail flicks near the bench leg. A half-open locker behind her holds a hanging towel; a small sports bag rests beside the near floor tiles. Keep the laid-out shirt and measuring contacts visible at eye level in a medium view. Warm ceiling light reveals the tape markings and white fabric folds, casting narrow finger shadows on the sleeve. The locker interior and the area beneath the bench remain softly shaded.
data.title: 娜娜 · 更衣室里偏长的制服袖口
data.identityProseOverride: Nana Asta Deviluke from To LOVE-Ru, Deviluke's feisty second princess with long pink twintails, purple-pink eyes and a black spade-heart tail
